title: Penthouse January 2008 Taya Parker Carmen Electra Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, January 2008. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover and Pet: Taya Parker.

Cover features: Taya Parker, entertainer of the year; Master of his domain - the 30-day experiment; Snipers under fire - a military outrage; plus Colin McRae, Carmen Electra, Nikki Sixx and Judd Apatow.

Back cover: Djarum clove cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
